Name: Qi Speed
Author: literaltree
Description:
[size=3][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=2]Are you annoyed that the endgame item Qi Seasoning has an unnecessary restriction on speed buffs?[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=2]Well be annoyed no more! This very simple C# mod allows Qi Seasoning to increase speed buffs when cooking.[/size][/color]

[size=3][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip the contents to your mods folder.[/color][/size]

[size=3][b]Source on Codeberg:[/b][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://codeberg.org/literal_tree/Qi-Speed]https://codeberg.org/literal_tree/StardewValleyMods/src/branch/main/Qi-Speed[/url][/color][/size]
